review:
Big Bass Day at the Races takes the fisherman off the water and onto the racecourse. The 5x3 reels and 10 paylines carry racing-themed symbols such as beer, binoculars and champagne flutes, but the Big Bass mechanics are still there underneath.

Three scatters trigger the bonus, and landing two can activate a random feature that tries to add the third. Before free spins start you pick from a line-up of horses, each revealing a feature for the round: more spins, assured cash prizes, removal of the lowest prize value and others. The collect-and-retrigger system continues, with every four fishermen granting extra spins. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a max win here. A fun change of scenery for the series that keeps everything familiar.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating

Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
